name: Heroku
summary:
Heroku is the app platform at heroku.com. The purple mark in the tab is the icon app dashboards show, with the format detected from the file.

Checked 12 November 2026 against heroku.com. HTML came from https://www.heroku.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: icon 32x32 → https://www.heroku.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/apple-touch-icon-180x180-1.png?w=32; icon 192x192 → https://www.heroku.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/apple-touch-icon-180x180-1.png?w=180; apple-touch-icon → https://www.heroku.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/apple-touch-icon-180x180-1.png?w=180.

The favicon.ico URL is https://heroku.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 198 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://www.heroku.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/apple-touch-icon-180x180-1.png?w=180, measured at 180×180 webp.

Brand colour #5a1ba9 comes from the theme-color meta tag.

Largest measured bitmap: webp-180x180-01.webp at 180×180 (webp, 8158 bytes) from https://www.heroku.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/apple-touch-icon-180x180-1.png?w=180.
